expected_events_meta.written: 2026-11-12, before any full-run output existed (pilot traces and geometry only)
expected_events_meta.axes: x_m = trace_x_m_first + i*dx (0.40 + 0.02 i, Tx/Rx midpoint); t_ns = time_of_sample0_ns + k*dt with time_of_sample0_ns 0.0 (raw simulation time, two-way)
expected_events_meta.t_definition: expected envelope (Hilbert) peak = source peak sqrt(2)/f (2.8284 ns) + ray time + wavelet lag 0.036 ns
expected_events_meta.x_definition: apex = trace position (0.02 m grid) of minimum ray time of that path; null for flat events (every trace)
expected_events_meta.apparent_depth_m: v*(t_ns - t_surface)/2, v = c/3, t_surface = pilot surface-reflection peak (K7_REF - FS) of the same sigma

kinds.multiple_layer: any path with a reflection at the eps 9/12 boundary (pipe illuminated or seen via the boundary)
kinds.flat_layer: flat boundary reflection and its surface multiple (x_m null, every trace)
kinds.pvc_internal: air-filled PVC bottom-wall reflection and air-fill reverberation (vertical approximation)

expected_events_meta.enumeration: pipe chains with <= 3 pipe scatterings, <= 2 bounces (surface or boundary, including antenna legs via the boundary), scatterings + bounces <= 3, plus same-pipe surface multiples up to order 2 (P-S-P-S-P); straight pipe-pipe legs blocked by a third pipe are dropped (P3 A-C); reciprocal paths are one event; equal curves merged; events later than 54 ns dropped
expected_events_meta.attach_window: x +-0.10 m (flat events: any x), t +-1 ns; ambiguous_with lists other events inside the window
expected_events_meta.amplitude_caveat: 2D line-source amplitudes; boundary reflection coefficient (3 - 3.464)/(3 + 3.464) = -0.072, so multiple_layer events are weak

K7_REF_S003 pilot finished 11:58 (exit 0): surface-reflection zero 3.6151 ns (S002 substitute 3.6156 ns, difference -0.0005 ns), lateral residual 3.0e-6 / 2.1e-6, late-time last 5 ns / max 0.9e-7 to 1.0e-7. Effect: t_ns unchanged (independent of the zero); apparent_depth_m of K7_P1_D150_S003 changes by < 0.001 m (about 0.03 mm), so the listed values stand
